summary: First-cycle end-to-end testing of Hetal Finserv marketing site. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed (health, /api/leads POST+GET, invalid phone 422, missing name 422, /api/contacts POST+GET, invalid email 422, /api/callbacks POST + invalid phone 422). Frontend: Home hero renders with masked headline 'Wealth, architected with heritage.', navbar + Book Consultation CTA visible, WhatsApp float visible with valid wa.me href (https://wa.me/919820012345). All 4 routes (/ , /services, /about, /contact) navigate correctly. Services page shows all 6 practice sections. Contact lead form submits successfully and shows lead-success-panel; lead was persisted (verified via previous API tests). Mobile viewport 375px: mobile-menu-toggle opens mobile-menu-panel with all nav links + book CTA + contact details.

issues: 'Thank you. We'll be in touch shortly.' heading appears low-contrast/dim on the obsidian background in the success state (heading rendered in a muted ivory/gold tone). Body text and 'Send another' CTA are readable, but the H3 could use higher contrast to feel triumphant/on-brand.

Console error from Google Maps embed script (gstatic init_embed.js): 'ReferenceError: google is not defined'. Non-blocking (external script), but the embed may fail on some environments — consider using an <iframe src='https://www.google.com/maps/embed...'> pattern instead of the JS API to avoid the error.

action_items: (Optional) Improve contrast of the lead-success-panel H3 heading on obsidian background so 'Thank you.' reads at higher legibility.
(Optional) Replace Google Maps JS-API embed on /contact with a simple <iframe> embed to eliminate the 'google is not defined' console error.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean: uses async motor, excludes _id via projection, UUID string ids, Pydantic v2 validators, ISO datetime serialization. No hardcoded URLs or credentials.
PHONE_RE regex ^[+\d][\d\s\-]{7,17}$ correctly rejects 'abc' and accepts '+919820012345'.
CORS uses env var with '*' fallback — acceptable for marketing site v1.
Frontend api.js uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly. All interactive elements carry data-testid attributes as documented.
seed_data_creation: Test-prefixed rows (TEST_*) inserted into leads/contacts/callbacks collections via API during pytest; no cleanup fixture (harmless for a fresh marketing DB, but next agent may want to add teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs via `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. All 9 tests pass in ~1s. Frontend runs at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://hetal-trust.preview.emergentagent.com). All primary data-testids listed in the review request are present and working. Only non-blocking design polish items remain.
